newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer says H1 1997 as expected.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer says H1 1997 as expected.

text.p: Sulzer AG said the first half of 1997 had gone according to expectations but declined to elaborate on its targets for the six month period.
"We have no numbers yet, but it was generally in line with expectations," chief financial officer Erich Mueller told reporters when asked about the first half.
Mueller was speaking to reporters after a news conference on the spin off of medical technology unit Sulzer Medica, which will start trading the week of July 14.

Sulzer, a diverse technology group whose products range from oil pumps to artificial knee joints, has said it 1997 profits to climb again after two years of sharp decline that prompted major restructuring.
Sulzer net profit fell 53 percent in 1995 to 92 million Swiss francs and dropped another 11 percent last year to 82 million.
